matrix_encoding.q_bitstring: Original Q entries in row-major order, ASCII 0/1, length J*K.
matrix_encoding.q_sha256: SHA256 of ASCII str(J) + ',' + str(K) + ':' + q_bitstring.

timing_definitions.algorithm_time: Wall-clock time inside identify(), starting after input/option validation; includes basis reduction, executed submatrix checks, and the SAT path (CNF construction, solver setup/solve, certificate checking and lifting). Excludes matrix generation, original-matrix diagnostics, response-class counting, provenance, and CSV I/O.
timing_definitions.basis_time: Wall-clock time for basis reduction within identify().
timing_definitions.diagnostics_time: Wall-clock time after identify() for original-Q flags, M_basis, and other diagnostics; outside algorithm_time.
timing_definitions.generation_time: Wall-clock time for sampling and validating the original Q; outside algorithm_time.
timing_definitions.identity_check_time: Wall-clock time for the executed identity-submatrix check.
timing_definitions.preprocess_time: Sum of basis_time and the three recorded submatrix-check times.
timing_definitions.sat_time: Wall-clock SAT-path time reported by identify(), including CNF construction, solver setup/solve and SAT certificate checks; not solver-only time. Zero when SAT is skipped.
timing_definitions.three_col_check_time: Wall-clock time for the executed three-column check; zero if skipped.
timing_definitions.two_col_check_time: Wall-clock time for the executed two-column check; zero if skipped.
